summary: Implementation plan for the 100-Station City Route Saga Map (TV horizontal & mobile vertical), 10 progressive gameplay mechanics (1 introduced every 10 levels, max 1 per level), 4 detailed 3D vehicle types (Taxi 3, Minibus 15, Bus 25, Double Bus 40), 3D overhead flipped selection arrow, and strict Door-Gate-only passenger boarding with a high-contrast door ground pad.
